# AI Prompt URL Generator

> A page for a person. It builds a link that opens ChatGPT, Claude or
> Perplexity with a prompt already in the input box.

You do not need this page. It only joins a base URL and some query
parameters. Build the link yourself with the rules below.

The site has no API, no account and no server. It stores nothing except one
value for the sound setting.

## Build a link

Encode every value. Use a URL encoder, not string joining.

### ChatGPT

Base: `https://chatgpt.com/`

| Parameter | Value | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `q` | The prompt | yes |
| `hints` | One of `search`, `image`, `think`, `research`, `shopping`, `study`, `canvas` | no |
| `temporary-chat` | `true` keeps the chat out of the history | no |

Example: `https://chatgpt.com/?q=Explain+TCP+slow+start&hints=search`

### Claude

Base: `https://claude.ai/new`

| Parameter | Value | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `q` | The prompt | yes |
| `incognito` | Present, with no value, keeps the chat out of the history | no |

Example: `https://claude.ai/new?q=Explain+TCP+slow+start&incognito`

### Perplexity

Base: `https://www.perplexity.ai/search`

| Parameter | Value | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `q` | The prompt | yes |

Example: `https://www.perplexity.ai/search?q=Explain+TCP+slow+start`

## Length limit

Keep the URL at or below 7500 characters. Some servers answer a longer
request line with HTTP 431. Above that limit, open the base URL and put the
prompt on the clipboard instead.

## Source

https://github.com/cr2007/aichat-url-maker
